name: @debe/functions
description: The requestReschedule Cloud Function. Not deployed for this assessment, but written as the real thing rather than a mock.

scripts.//build: Bundle rather than tsc-emit. @debe/shared is a workspace package that does not exist on the Functions runtime, so a plain tsc build would deploy an import Node cannot resolve — the classic monorepo-to-Firebase failure, and one that only shows up after deploy. esbuild inlines it. firebase-functions and firebase-admin stay external because the runtime provides them.
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
